compare.title: What changes as RADR takes on more.

items.a: Monthly prices and numeric usage allowances are being finalized. They will be published before paid activation, so you can compare standard packages without requesting a custom quote. Selecting a plan here previews setup; it does not start a payment or subscription.

items.q: Can I explore RADR before choosing a plan?
items.a: Yes. Register for the free fictional restaurant or hotel demo and explore at your own pace. There is no immediate pricing prompt or automatic conversion to a paid plan.

items.q: Do I need a sales call or an onboarding specialist?
items.a: The standard setup path is self-guided: choose your operation, follow the checklist and prepare supported data files. Your team owns its data and reviews proposed actions. The packages do not include a dedicated account manager, data-cleaning service or bespoke implementation.

items.q: Is there a separate setup fee?
items.a: Guided setup and documentation are part of the proposed packages, rather than a separately sold implementation service. Final subscription terms will be published before paid activation. There is no setup charge on this preview.

A location is one restaurant, hotel or operating venue. Core is designed for one location, Expand for up to five and Portfolio for up to twenty. A hotel's rooms are part of that hotel's location, rather than separate locations.

items.q: What if I need more locations or data?
items.a: Choose a larger standard package when its location capacity fits. Data and processing limits, capacity upgrades and billing terms will be published before paid activation. No automatic overage charge is enabled in this preview.

items.q: Can RADR connect to any system automatically?
items.a: Check the documented file requirements and provider availability first. A provider logo does not guarantee a live connection. The packages do not include building custom integrations or a managed data-migration service.

items.q: Do you take a percentage of our savings?
items.a: No percentage of modeled or expected savings is part of these packages. The proposed model is a standard subscription. Expected value remains separate from an evidenced, verified outcome.
